messages:
alex: Quick idea: add lightweight provenance probes + a non-invasive audit event for late/missing token detection. main aim: surface problems to billing before ledger finalization.

nina: ok, can you sketch what a probe looks like? frequency, payload, and where it runs?

alex: probe = tiny heartbeat emitted by ingest shard that includes shard_id, tenant_sample_hash, last_event_ts, and a compact token_fingerprint_sample. default every 5m for active shards. payload ~ few fields so cost low.

prateek: question: how do we distinguish low-activity tenants vs dropped traffic? we don't want to page on normal customer silence.

alex: plan: tiered decision tree. only consider tenants with >0 tokens in the last X days (configurable). compute per-tenant `silence_score` = time_since_last_event / expected_interarrival(latency_quantile). then only emit `provenance_alert` if silence_score > threshold *AND* tenant_activity_flag=true.

nina: agree. also prefer emitting audit events, not automatic adjustments. Events should contain pointers for a targeted backfill job, e.g. start_event_id, end_event_id, fingerprint_range. ops triggers actual ledger ops after human/billing approval.

prateek: add `repair_suggested_by` and `repair_runbook` fields to the audit event so triage is straightforward. include a `repair_confidence` score (low/medium/high) based on available fingerprints.

ops-bot: note: last quarter we had noisy late-credit alerts when generic thresholds were used. recommend percentile-based thresholds and a suppression window.

alex: yep we'll use adaptive thresholds by traffic quantiles, plus a noise suppression TTL per-tenant (e.g., do not alert more than once per 24h unless severity escalates).

nina: what about metric cardinality? per-tenant heartbeats explode metrics.

prateek: bucketed aggregation at ingest layer: track `provenance_heartbeat.count` by tenant_tier, region, and shard_bucket. only emit per-tenant metrics for enterprise flag. keep raw proofs in audit events (S3/warehouse) not in metric system.

alex: sample SQL for quick triage (warehouse):
```
SELECT tenant_id, max(event_ts) as last_seen, count(*) as tokens_7d
FROM metering_events
WHERE event_ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY tenant_id
HAVING max(event_ts) < now() - interval '15 minutes'
ORDER BY tokens_7d DESC
LIMIT 200;
```

nina: + dashboard panels: `heartbeat.missing_rate`, `provenance_alerts.by_tier`, `time_since_last_event.p50/p95`. paging rule: page on `provenance_alerts.severity=high` OR missing_rate > 0.2% sustained 10m.

prateek: schema suggestion for audit event (compact): `{"type":"provenance_alert","tenant_id":"...","shard":"...","last_seen":"...","fingerprints":["f1","f2"],"repair_runbook":"url","repair_confidence":"medium","repair_suggested_by":"ingest-observer","repair_event_id":"uuid"}`. keep it denormalized so downstream tools don't need joins.

alex: note re idempotency: include `repair_event_id` in any follow-up repair actions so billing can de-dupe. also sign/verify event with provenance signature to avoid tampering.

nina: ownership: ingest/observer = detection + emit audit, billing = decision + trigger adjustment. SRE/infra maintain dashboards and suppression configs. we'll add RBAC on per-tenant drilldowns.

ops-bot: action item: create RFC PR with: probe proto, alert schema, metric buckets, suppression, sample queries, and runbook template. tag @billing-team.

alex: i'll draft RFC tonight. nina/prateek will add dashboards and schema PR respectively. follow-up 30m after RFC posted.

all: :thumbsup:
